00053     inline void prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize)
00054     {
00055         if(externalOutput != 0)
00056         {
00057             externalOutput->prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize);
00058             blockSize = externalOutput->getBlockSize();
00059             block = externalOutput->getSampleData();
00060         }
00061         else if(usingExternalOutput)
00062         {
00063             // assert if actualBlockSize != blockSize
00064         }
00065         else
00066         {
00067             blockSize = actualBlockSize;
00068             
00069             if(actualBlockSize > allocatedBlockSize)
00070             {       
00071                 delete [] block;
00072                 allocatedBlockSize = blockSize;
00073                 block = new float[allocatedBlockSize];
00074             }
00075         }
00076     }
00077     //void optimiseBlockSize(); // reduce block sizes to minimum
00078     
00079     //inline float getOutputValue() const                   { if(usingExternalOutput) return externalOutput->getOutputValue(); else return output;      }
00080     //inline void setOutputValue(const float newValue)  { if(usingExternalOutput) externalOutput->setOutputValue(newValue); else output = newValue; }
00081     inline int getBlockSize() const                     { return blockSize;         }
00082     inline float* getSampleData() const                 { return block;             }
00083     inline void zeroAllData()                           { memset(block, 0, blockSize * sizeof(float)); }
00084     
00085     void useExternalOutput(UGenOutput* externalOutputToUse);
00086     void useExternalOutput(float* externalOutputToUse, const int externalBlockSize);
00087     
00088 private:
00089     //float output;
00090     float *block;
00091     int blockSize;
00092     int allocatedBlockSize;
00093     bool usingExternalOutput;
00094     UGenOutput* externalOutput;
00095 };

00300 class ReleasableUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00301 {
00302 public:
00303     
00306     
00307     ReleasableUGenInternal(const int numInputs) throw() 
00308     :   UGenInternal(numInputs), 
00309         shouldRelease_(false), 
00310         shouldSteal_(false),
00311         isReleasing_(false),
00312         isStealing_(false),
00313         isDone_(false) { }
00314     
00315     virtual void release() = 0;
00316     virtual void steal() = 0;
00317     
00319     
00322     
00323     inline bool shouldRelease() const throw()   { return shouldRelease_;    }
00324     inline bool shouldSteal() const throw()     { return shouldSteal_;      }
00325     inline bool isReleasing() const throw()     { return isReleasing_;      }
00326     inline bool isStealing() const throw()      { return isStealing_;       }
00327     inline bool isDone() const throw()          { return isDone_;           }
00328         
00330     
00331 protected:
00332     inline void releaseInternal() throw()   
00333     { 
00334         if(shouldRelease_ == false && shouldSteal_ != true)
00335         {
00336             UGenInternal::releaseInternal(); 
00337             shouldRelease_ = true; 
00338             release();
00339         }
00340     }
00341     inline void stealInternal() throw() 
00342     {
00343         if(shouldSteal_ == false)
00344         {
00345             shouldRelease_ = true;
00346             shouldSteal_ = true; 
00347             UGenInternal::stealInternal(); 
00348             steal();
00349         }
00350     }
00351     inline void setIsReleasing() throw()        { if(shouldRelease_) isReleasing_ = true;           }
00352     inline void setIsStealing() throw()         { if(shouldSteal_) isStealing_ = true;              }
00353     void setIsDone() throw()                    { isDone_ = true;                                   }
00354     
00355     bool shouldRelease_;
00356     bool shouldSteal_;
00357     bool isReleasing_;
00358     bool isStealing_;
00359     bool isDone_;
00360 };
